items.summary: Do not treat scorecard entries showing revenue_usd=0 and AI cost as contribution-margin losses. Those entries lack matching-period site-attributed revenue and complete non-AI cost allocation; they are spend-versus-unobserved-revenue indicators only. Contribution margin requires attributable revenue minus variable AI, infrastructure, affiliate, and other directly allocable costs for the same site and period.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue and cost reconciliation work item only. Preserve unknowns for infrastructure spend, fixed costs, budgets, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and cost-to-learn because no matching-period cost ledger or monthly budget limits are present in the brief. The minimum financial control artifact is a dated site/content ledger reconciling provider earnings, AI spend, infrastructure spend, and other variable costs to the same measurement window.

Retain containment-only execution while delivery is full at 10/10 slots, 45 deployed improvements await measurement, 21 implementation requests failed, and 7 repair follow-ups remain open. No financial case supports adding work before existing measurement and repair obligations produce dated evidence. Reconsider only after a slot clears and the retained finance reconciliation has matched-period cost and revenue evidence.
